historia.texto: Primeira de duas noites no Barclays Center, com o Lightning Bolt recém-saído. O Eddie agradeceu a quem construiu a arena, citou um deles, o Jay Z, e emendou: "We got 99 problems but a place to play ain't one". Infallible foi pra Harper e Olivia. Sirens começou e parou nos primeiros acordes porque o violão de 12 cordas do Mike não funcionava, e o Eddie brincou que aquele pedacinho ficou fora do disco por pouco e ia virar lado B num tal de Pearl Jam's Greatest Misses. Mais tarde, com problema no violão do próprio Eddie, o Mike segurou a espera tocando Eruption. Antes de Chloe Dancer/Crown of Thorns, ele falou do Andrew Wood: nunca o conheceu, mas pensa muito nele. Em Porch, os globos de luz desceram e o Eddie subiu num deles e cantou balançando. No segundo bis, disse a um fã com cartaz de 100 shows que devia uma bebida a ele.
historia.rotuloFonte: Fanviews do fórum oficial do Pearl Jam

fontes.trecho: We know one of them, Jay Z, so let’s thanks Jay Z.  We got 99 problems but a place to play ain’t one.
This next song is for Harper and Olivia.  It’s called “Infallible”.

The band starts “Sirens” but Mike’s 12 string acoustic isn’t working so after a few chords the band stop playing.  Ed says, “That last little song didn’t make the record but it came this close.  It is going to be a b-side released in February on a record called ‘Pearl Jam’s Greatest Misses’.
There was some trouble with Ed’s 12 string acoustic during “Sirens” so before they go into the next song Ed says, “I need to find out what happened to that guitar.
“This next song was written by someone everybody up here knew.  I never met him but I think about him a lot, a lot, a lot.

During Porch the globe lights come down from the light truss.  They all get pushed by the band so they start swinging.  Ed whacks one with his mic stand.  He then jumps on the globe and Matt’s tech hands him his microphone so he can sing while swinging.
tells a guy up front with a sign saying he has been to 100 shows that Ed owes the guy a drink.
